text: Scaled dot product self attention divides query key similarities by the square root of the key dimension before softmax.
english: scaled dot product self attention key dimension
chinese: 点积注意力怎样缩放查询与键的相似度？
background: 点积注意力在 softmax 前使用键维数平方根缩放相似度。

text: Dropout randomly disables hidden units during training to reduce coadaptation and regularize neural networks.
english: dropout randomly disables hidden units training
chinese: 随机失活怎样减少神经网络单元共同适应？
background: 随机失活通过训练时随机停用隐藏单元减少共同适应。

text: Batch normalization standardizes activations using minibatch mean and variance with learned scale and offset parameters.
english: batch normalization minibatch mean variance activations
chinese: 批归一化如何利用小批次均值方差处理激活？
background: 批归一化依据小批次均值和方差标准化激活，并学习缩放与偏移。

text: Residual networks add identity shortcut connections so layers learn residual mappings instead of complete transformations.
chinese: 残差网络的恒等捷径连接让层学习什么？
background: 残差网络利用恒等捷径连接，使层学习残差映射。

text: Convolution applies shared local filters across spatial positions to extract translation equivariant image features.
english: convolution shared local filters translation equivariant
chinese: 卷积的共享局部滤波器如何提取平移等变特征？
background: 卷积在空间位置共享局部滤波器，以提取平移等变图像特征。

text: Contrastive learning pulls representations of positive pairs together while separating representations of negative pairs.
chinese: 对比学习如何处理正样本对和负样本对的表示？
background: 对比学习拉近正样本对的表示，分离负样本对的表示。

text: Knowledge distillation transfers information from a teacher model to a student model using softened output distributions.
english: knowledge distillation teacher student softened distributions
chinese: 知识蒸馏如何用软化输出将教师信息传给学生？
background: 知识蒸馏使用软化输出分布，将教师模型的信息传给学生模型。

text: Beam search keeps a bounded set of high scoring partial sequences and expands them during autoregressive decoding.
english: beam search partial sequences autoregressive decoding
chinese: 束搜索在自回归解码中保留和扩展哪些序列？
background: 束搜索在自回归解码中保留有限个高分部分序列并继续扩展。

text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves relevant source passages and conditions generated answers on those passages.
english: retrieval augmented generation relevant source passages
chinese: 检索增强生成怎样让回答依据相关原文段落？
background: 检索增强生成检索相关来源段落，并以这些段落为条件生成回答。

text: A vector database indexes dense embeddings and supports similarity search over stored document representations.
english: vector database dense embeddings similarity search
chinese: 向量数据库怎样索引文档表示并进行相似度搜索？
background: 向量数据库索引稠密嵌入，并对已存储的文档表示进行相似度搜索。

text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines retrieval rankings using reciprocal rank contributions without requiring comparable raw scores.
english: reciprocal rank fusion retrieval rankings scores
chinese: 倒数排名融合为何不要求原始检索分数可比？
background: 倒数排名融合使用倒数排名贡献组合检索排序，因此无需可比的原始分数。

text: Adam maintains exponentially decayed estimates of gradient first moments and second moments to adapt parameter updates.
english: adam gradient first second moments parameter updates
chinese: 自适应矩估计优化器怎样使用梯度一阶和二阶矩？
background: Adam 维护梯度一阶和二阶矩的指数衰减估计，以调整参数更新。

text: Principal component analysis projects centered observations onto orthogonal directions that maximize explained variance.
english: principal component analysis orthogonal explained variance
chinese: 主成分分析如何选择解释方差最大的正交方向？
background: 主成分分析将中心化观测投影到解释方差最大的正交方向。

text: Cross validation partitions observations into training and held out folds to estimate model generalization performance.
english: cross validation held out folds generalization
chinese: 交叉验证怎样用留出折估计模型泛化性能？
background: 交叉验证将观测分为训练折和留出折，以估计模型泛化性能。

text: Bootstrap resampling draws samples with replacement from observed data to estimate uncertainty in a statistic.
chinese: 自助重采样怎样通过有放回抽样估计统计量不确定性？
background: 自助重采样从观测数据有放回抽样，以估计统计量的不确定性。
